text_en: The Lord is king; let the peoples tremble! He sits enthroned upon the cherubim; let the earth quake!
text_cn: 上主为王，万民因而战栗惊恐， 他坐于革鲁宾之上，大地震动；

text_en: The Lord is great in Zion; he is exalted over all the peoples.
text_cn: 熙雍的上主，伟大堂皇， 崇高尊贵，而超越万邦。

text_en: Let them praise your great and awesome name. Holy is he!
text_cn: 愿他们赞美你的大名， 它可敬可畏，至尊神圣。

text_en: Mighty King, lover of justice, you have established equity; you have executed justice and righteousness in Jacob.
text_cn: 你是爱正义的大能君王， 是你制定了法律的正纲， 对雅各伯行的合理合章。

text_en: Extol the Lord our God; worship at his footstool. Holy is he!
text_cn: 请你们尊崇上主，我们的天主， 还要向着他的脚凳伏地叩首。 因为他的脚凳也是神圣无偶。

text_en: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel also was among those who called on his name. They cried to the Lord , and he answered them.
text_cn: 梅瑟和亚郎列于上主的司祭中， 撒慕尔属于呼号他圣名的人中， 他们呼号上主，上主即俯听他们。

text_en: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud; they kept his decrees, and the statutes that he gave them.
text_cn: 他从前曾在云柱中训示了他们， 他们就守了他吩咐的诫命章程。

text_en: O Lord our God, you answered them; you were a forgiving God to them, but an avenger of their wrongdoings.
text_cn: 上主，你原是我们的天主，你曾俯听了他们， 天主，你宽宥他们，但也报复了他们的恶行。

text_en: Extol the Lord our God, and worship at his holy mountain; for the Lord our God is holy.
text_cn: 请你们尊崇上主，我们的天主， 还要向着他的圣山伏地叩首， 因我们的天主，上主神圣无偶。
